description: Nirosh Amantha Amadoru v. Hon. Attorney General Nirosh Amantha Amadoru v. Hon. Attorney General View More before Hon. L.T.B. Dehideniya, J
parties: Nirosh Amantha Amadoru v. Hon. Attorney General Nirosh Amantha Amadoru v. Hon. Attorney General View More
keywords: Revision – Dishonoured cheques/misappropriation – Trial in absentia – Magistrate’s sentence – High Court sitting in appeal varying punishment – Compensation of Rs.800,000 on each count – Default imprisonment – Appellate court cannot impose punishment exceeding what court of first instance could lawfully impose – Excessive default term – High Court judgment set aside – Magistrate’s sentence restored.
legistation: Debt Recovery (Special Provisions) Act No. 2 of 1990, as amended by Act No. 4 of 1994 – section 25(1)(D); Penal Code – section 391; Code of Criminal Procedure Act – section 328 and provisions governing default imprisonment.
